2026 model-performance audit

All completed Weeks 1–5. Current roster tracked retrospectively. Upcoming outcomes are excluded. Reconstructed causal replays and forecasts actually saved before kickoff are kept separate.

Predicted vs actual: 45-degree plot

X = actual points; Y = predicted mean. Vertical whiskers are the 10th–90th percentile predictive interval. Above the diagonal means overprediction; below means underprediction. Tap a point for its player/week details.

Individual roster player: week-by-week

Blue = replay mean and 80% interval; orange = actual; gold diamond = archived pregame prediction. Missing actuals are shown as gaps, not zeros.

Weekly calibration and training variance

Training is in-sample and optimistic. MAE whiskers bootstrap rows within a week; error whiskers show one residual standard deviation. These are different from predictive intervals.

Chronological calibration candidate

Candidate only; no model promotion. Corrections use earlier replay weeks, with unchanged mean predictions. Select the calibration evidence above to inspect expanded intervals. Coverage is measured, not guaranteed under dependent outcomes.
